entries.title: Launcher 0.1.29
items: ## Downloading
Downloads now use your whole connection. Large files were being fetched one piece at a time down a single connection, which made an install far slower than it should have been.
The progress card shows how many files are done, the total speed and time left, and every file currently downloading with its own progress.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.28
items: ## Installing and updating
Updates now download only the files that changed, instead of the whole game.
Installing takes far less free space, and no longer unpacks a second copy of the game onto your drive.
Downloads no longer time out on slower connections.
An interrupted download picks up where it stopped instead of starting the file over.
The launcher clears out leftover install files it no longer needs and tells you how much space it freed.
## Your files
New Verify files button checks every game file and reports what is wrong, without changing anything.
Repair now restores a file you deleted. It previously reported success and did nothing.
Changes you make under platform are detected by content, so an edit that leaves the file the same size is no longer missed.
Your keybinds and HUD layout are no longer overwritten when you update.
## Playing
Play is no longer blocked when the master server cannot be reached.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.27
items: Credit RoyalBlue1 for SERE.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.26
items: ## Patch notes
Group the game patch notes under headings instead of one flat list.
## Joining
Launch online when you join from the server browser, even if Play Local is set to Offline.
Hide the console mode and map pickers when you join a server from the browser.
## Install
Fix a finished install still painting the Install button.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.25
items: Clear stray server processes before Play Local starts and wait for the port, so a failed run does not block the next one.
Replace the play bar with one button that becomes STOP, CHANGE MAP or DISCONNECT.
Split the console tab into two panes so server output survives launching the game.
Make Reload on the console tab change to the live map.
Add Ctrl+F find in both console panes.
Warn on a server script crash, offer a restart, and reconnect the game you still have open.
Group Play Local modes into an Apex and a Flowstate rail.
Lead the map hero with the mode and show the launch command.
Add resolution fields to the play bar and settings, with per-aspect presets from your monitor's real modes.
Make DirectX 12 a session-only choice, marked Beta.
Add a per-side Developer switch and a host-online toggle to Advanced.
Add match cards to Leaderboards and make both cards closable.
Tuck the Beta mark up against the wordmark.
Drop the AI label from the patch notes tabs.
Move Map Editor out of Play Local; it stays in the Advanced playlist list.
Keep map picker tiles instead of redecoding them every open.
Update credits.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.17
items: If the local server hits a script error or crashes, the launcher asks to restart it and reconnects the game that is still open.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.15
items: 1v1 leaderboard: search by name, season filter, All seasons, and win streaks.
Click a player for maps, weapons, best game, and recent matches (duration and host).
Match history page with paging. Live server and player counts on Play and Leaderboards.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.14
items: The launcher opens instantly: news and update checks load in the background instead of holding up the window.
Works offline and on slow networks: the last known catalog and notes show right away.
Smoother and more responsive overall, especially after sitting idle.
Faster startup on machines where it used to hang on a white screen.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.13
items: Map pictures in the launcher show again.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.12
items: Console tab redesigned: server controls sit in a bottom bar like the main page, and the tabs never collapse.
Offline is on by default for local play. Joining a public server goes online automatically.
Patch notes open at the top and version-title each update.
The launcher opens at a tighter default window size.
Advanced mode: Launch Client and Launch Dedi keep their own consoles.
Added missing translations for the close and preflight dialogs.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.11
items: The launcher speaks your language: the whole shell is localized into all game languages.
Console: one pane for local play - the client log starts from its very first line and server startup lines stay visible.
Change map applies the selected playlist.
Credits tab redesigned: tighter layout, hover highlights, short repo links, and the CafeFPS X profile.
Bigger header logo and title; footer stays visible when maximized.
Patch notes now label the current game version (v0.9.1 beta) instead of saying Current build.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.10
items: New window look: the Windows title bar is gone, replaced by the launcher's own slim caption bar with minimize, maximize, and close.
Drag the top strip to move the window; double-click it to maximize.
Closing the launcher always closes it. You can stop the game, leave it running, or cancel.
Quitting a public-server session no longer asks about a leftover local server.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.9
items: First-run welcome note for playtesters with what to expect and how to help.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.8
items: Game updates that only change scripts or game code now show as a small UPDATE instead of the full install screen.
An open launcher checks for game updates every 10 minutes; no restart needed to see them.
Launcher updates show next to the version number: Update available, then Restart to apply the update. Click it to restart.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.7
items: Fixed Play Local getting stuck on Waiting for the server: if the server is running but never reports ready, the game now starts anyway after 75 seconds.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.6
items: Patch Notes now has two pages: Game and Launcher. Every launcher version carries its own changelog.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.5
items: New installs go to Program Files. Setup asks for admin once; playing, updating, and downloading never prompt again.
Browse always applies the folder you pick, and tells you when Windows blocks a location instead of failing silently.
Download speed limit in Settings. Presets from 5 to 200 Mbps, applied immediately, even mid-download.
One install progress bar instead of three, with whole-download progress and bytes.
The install header now reads Installing / Checking while work is running.
Console command history: Up and Down recall previous commands, kept across restarts.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.4
items: Pick the map from its loading-screen art. The map dropdown is gone; the Select map button on the artwork opens the picker.
Console input caret lands where you click.
The launcher switches to the Console tab while the local server loads the map.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.3
items: Quick Play waits for the server to finish loading the map before starting the game.
1v1 ranked leaderboards tab.
Warns when the install drive is short on space.
Download shows time remaining for the whole install.

entries.title: Launcher 0.1.0 - 0.1.2
items: First public launcher: installs and updates the game from the CDN.
Play Local with modes, server browser, hosted server and client consoles, patch notes, and credits.
Password-protected server join and EULA flow.
